watches.name: THAL 300 Skeleton Tourbillon — Signal Orange
watches.description: High horology, built for depth. Most tourbillons are created for the display case. THAL 300 was created to descend. At its center, a fully skeletonized mechanical movement reveals a luminous tourbillon at six o'clock, framed by sandblasted bridges and contrasting rose-gold flanks. Surrounding the movement, a lume-infused carbon-fiber bezel forms a powerful circle of light, joined by luminous hands for visibility as the water darkens. Everything is protected inside a 42 mm crystallized-titanium case rated to 300 meters. At only 12 mm thick and approximately 33 grams, THAL 300 delivers the strength and capability of a serious diving watch with the lightness and refinement of high horology. Signal Orange — inspired by high-visibility marine equipment and the final light on the horizon. Signal Orange surrounds the exposed mechanical architecture with a warm, intense glow designed to command attention above or below the surface. Each Signal Orange watch includes two matching 20 mm straps: a lightweight orange elastic-fabric strap and a premium orange FKM rubber strap. watches.name: Strange — Grandeur × KOTA
watches.description: A rare artistic collaboration between Belal Shaher and DAKOTA SCHUETZ® — “Kota”. Belal Shaher, watch designer and founder of Grandeur, joins forces with DAKOTA SCHUETZ®, famously known as Kota, to create Strange — a highly artistic limited-edition mechanical watch. Designed by Belal Shaher, Strange features an in-house mechanical jump hour movement, while the dial carries Kota’s distinctive artistic vision. This collaboration brings together two creative worlds: the precision and complexity of mechanical watchmaking, and the expressive energy of contemporary hand-drawn art. Adding to the uniqueness of the project, Kota has personally created hand-drawn artwork on each watch box — making every box completely one of a kind. No two pieces are the same, giving each collector a unique work of art alongside the watch itself. Limited to only 25 pieces worldwide , Strange stands as one of the most exclusive and desirable collaborations from both artists — a true meeting point between art, design, and mechanical watchmaking.

watches.name: Grandeur Lyra
watches.description: Grandeur Lyra — Your Melody, Mechanically Preserved The Grandeur Lyra is a 42 mm tonneau-shaped mechanical timepiece created around one extraordinary idea: a music box watch that can play the melody you choose . Its main feature is a changeable mechanical music box cylinder , allowing the owner to replace the cylinder and experience different melodies within the same watch. Each music cylinder is produced using metal 3D-printing technology , enabling Grandeur to create highly precise, customized melody cylinders for each client. Beyond Grandeur’s standard melody options, customers will be able to personalize their own music cylinder through the Grandeur website. A client may select or submit a preferred song or melody, and Grandeur will transform that melody into a dedicated mechanical cylinder — turning a personal piece of music into a physical horological component. This makes Lyra more than a watch. It becomes a personal mechanical instrument: a timepiece that can carry a memory, a love song, a family theme, a wedding melody, or any meaningful composition chosen by its owner. At the heart of Lyra is an in-house mechanical movement with separate power-reserve barrels: one dedicated to timekeeping, and another dedicated to the music box mechanism. This allows the hours and minutes to remain independent from the musical complication, preserving stable timekeeping while giving the music system its own source of energy. The case measures 42 mm wide , with a balanced 50 mm lug-to-lug length and a refined 12 mm thickness . Crafted in titanium with gold plating , the case is finished with additional protective layers for enhanced scratch resistance. The case sides and dial feature intricate laser engraving , followed by careful hand-finishing to create depth, contrast, and artisanal character. Protected by sapphire glass and paired with a thick crocodile leather strap , the Grandeur Lyra unites fine watchmaking, music, personalization, engraving, and modern manufacturing technology in one expressive timepiece. Key Features Changeable Music Box Cylinder Lyra allows the owner to change the mechanical music cylinder, giving the watch the ability to play different melodies. Custom Melody Creation Customers will be able to customize their own melody cylinder through the Grandeur website by selecting or submitting a preferred song. Metal 3D-Printed Cylinders Each custom music cylinder is created using metal 3D-printing technology, allowing precise production of personalized melodies. Separate Music and Time Barrels The in-house movement uses separate barrels for the timekeeping system and the music box mechanism. Mechanical Music Complication Lyra performs music mechanically, transforming a personal melody into a visible, tactile, and audible horological experience. Hand-Finished Engraving The dial and case sides feature laser engraving with hand-finishing for a rich, sculptural appearance. Specifications Model: Grandeur Lyra Case Shape: Tonneau Case Width: 42 mm Lug-to-Lug: 50 mm Thickness: 12 mm Case Material: Titanium with gold plating Protection: Additional scratch-resistant finishing layers Crystal: Sapphire glass Movement: In-house mechanical movement Power Reserve: Approximately 50 hours for timekeeping Music System: Changeable mechanical music box cylinder Cylinder Production: Metal 3D-printing technology Customization: Personalized melody cylinder available Functions: Hours, minutes, and music melodies Decoration: Laser engraving and hand-finishing on case side and dial Strap: Thick crocodile leather strap Limited Edition: Grandeur Lyra will be produced in a limited first edition of only 50 pieces . watches.description: The Singular Vision of Time The Grandeur Monocle represents a decisive moment in contemporary haute horlogerie—where mechanical audacity, material innovation, and architectural clarity converge into a singular expression of time. At its heart lies Grandeur’s in-house Jump Flap Hour Module , a world-first complication , officially registered and patented under the Grandeur name. This proprietary mechanism redefines the hour display through an instantaneous jumping “flap” aperture, paired with a sweeping retrograde minute indication that resets with controlled mechanical precision. Powering this innovation is a meticulously re-engineered Calibre 5000A base movement , enhanced by an unprecedented achievement in watchmaking: the world’s first stone micro-rotor , crafted from natural meteorite. This extraordinary rotor unites cosmic materiality with functional efficiency, transforming the act of winding into a celestial gesture. The Monocle’s dial and chapter ring are sculpted entirely from authentic meteorite stone , each piece revealing a unique Widmanstätten pattern formed over millions of years in space—ensuring that no two watches are ever alike. Encased within a refined 42 mm profile and only 10 mm in thickness , Monocle achieves remarkable mechanical density without compromising elegance. It is a watch designed not merely to be worn, but to be contemplated. Limited, uncompromising, and unmistakably Grandeur— Monocle is not an evolution of timekeeping. It is a declaration.

watches.name: MONOCLE AUREUM - Limited 35
watches.description: Officially entered as a competing watch in the 2026 Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève (GPHG) Essential category , the Grandeur Monocle Aureum represents an ambitious expression of independent American watchmaking. It brings together three world-first achievements spanning its time display, case construction, and winding mechanism. At its heart is Grandeur’s patent-pending JumpFlap™ Hour Module . The proprietary display features a moving hour aperture that travels through a 30-degree arc over the course of 60 minutes before snapping back instantaneously as the next hour appears. This action is synchronized with the sweeping retrograde minute indication positioned below, creating a theatrical yet highly intuitive presentation of time. Meteorite is used throughout the Monocle Aureum as both an artistic signature and a functional mechanical material. The hour ring and the surface surrounding the retrograde mechanism reveal the natural Widmanstätten pattern formed within the meteorite over millions of years. Because this crystalline structure is unique to every section of the material, no two Monocle Aureum watches can ever be identical. Powering the display is a meticulously re-engineered Hangzhou Caliber 5000A automatic movement , operating at 28,800 vibrations per hour and delivering approximately 40 hours of power reserve. Its winding system incorporates the world’s first micro-rotor precision-crafted from meteorite—transforming an ancient extraterrestrial material into an active mechanical component. The 42 mm × 10 mm titanium case features an exhibition sapphire caseback and an integrated meteorite case ring bored directly from a solid block of meteoritic stone—another world-first achievement. This technically demanding construction allows the Monocle Aureum to deliver exceptional mechanical density while maintaining an elegant and remarkably slim profile. Water-resistant to 30 meters and presented on a black leather strap, the Monocle Aureum balances mechanical innovation with refined everyday wearability. Limited to only 35 individually numbered pieces , it is a rare union of patented engineering, extraterrestrial material, and contemporary haute horlogerie. watches.description: Limited to 100 Pieces The Ætherium Collection marks a rare achievement in contemporary watchmaking, uniting natural stone and mechanical architecture in a way never before realized.
